name: pry-scraper
description: Professional web scraping and web search with x402 crypto payments. 15-tier anti-detection fallback, AI extraction, site maps, auto-signup, CAPTCHA solving. 99 MCP tools across web scraping, data extraction, monitoring, sports betting, legal intelligence, real estate, jobs, and more.
longDescription: Pry is a self-hosted web scraping and browser automation platform with native x402 micropayments. It routes each request through an adaptive 15-tier fallback chain — direct HTTP, TLS fingerprint impersonation, cloudscraper, FlareSolverr, undetected-chromedriver, Camoufox, Playwright stealth, Googlebot UA, Tor, premium proxies, Archive.org, Google Cache, AI visual scraping, mobile app API, and GraphQL discovery — escalating only as far as the target requires, then remembering what worked per domain. It also answers the two questions before a scrape: `POST /v1/search` returns ranked web results, and `POST /v1/map` lists a site's same-origin URLs. Every scrape reports `metadata.markdown_quality`, a 0-100 score of the extracted Markdown.
